original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯警察开枪致一名女孩死亡、另一人受伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州警察局一名助理警司在阿杰贡勒（Ajegunle）执行任务时枪支走火，造成两名女孩一死一伤。警方称事发时警员正应对两个团伙因收取过路费而发生的暴力冲突，涉事警员已被拘留。该事件目前为单一来源报道。

location.site: 阿杰贡勒 Nosamu 地区

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州警察局一名助理警司 Omotayo Olajide 在阿杰贡勒执行任务时枪支走火，致两名女孩一死一伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Lagos State Police Command has detained an Assistant Superintendent of Police, Omotayo Olajide, after his firearm discharged during an operation in Ajegunle, killing a girl and injuring another.
The Lagos State Police Command has detained an Assistant Superintendent of Police, Omotayo Olajide

key_facts.fact: 事发时间为11月5日周四晚9时30分至10时之间
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident occurred on Thursday, November 5, between 9.30 pm and 10 pm, in the Nosamu area of Ajegunle

key_facts.fact: 警方称警员系在接到两个团伙暴力冲突报警后出警
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the personnel had been deployed after a distress call about a violent clash between two rival groups, the Nosamu Boys and the Alayabiagba Boys, over toll collection

uncertainties: 事件细节目前仅来自单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
